reviewer: independent read-only visual design review (agent), round 1, 2026-10-13, at commit ee992e5 (3.0.1)
summary: Passes on looks: a finished product with its own P3R identity rather than a default template. The navy/cyan palette, slanted panels, calendar-plate dates, condensed italic numerals and faint character art hold together across the wizard, the four tabs, result sheets, settings, keypads and the widget in both palettes. No blocker or major defect; nothing badly clipped; contrast good; large-font renders hold. Remaining issues are Chinese typography and small-size polish.
